concepts.name: System Fundamentals
concepts.summary: Core building blocks of distributed systems, including performance metrics, scalability patterns, and foundational infrastructure components.

concepts.name: Data & Storage
concepts.summary: Databases, replication, sharding, consistency models, durability, and concurrency control strategies for managing data at scale.

concepts.name: Async & Reliability
concepts.summary: Message queues, stream processing, reliability engineering, and observability primitives for building resilient distributed systems.

concepts.name: AI Systems
concepts.summary: Machine learning infrastructure covering embeddings, retrieval, LLM inference, agentic systems, and model evaluation.

concepts.name: Latency & Metrics
concepts.summary: Percentile latency (p50/p95/p99), SLOs, SLAs, and the techniques used to measure and reduce tail latency in distributed services.

concepts.name: Scalability
concepts.summary: Horizontal vs. vertical scaling, stateless design, auto-scaling policies, and the capacity-planning approaches that let systems handle growing load.

concepts.name: Load Balancing
concepts.summary: Round-robin, least-connections, consistent hashing, and health-check strategies that distribute traffic across server fleets without hot spots.

concepts.name: Caching
concepts.summary: In-process, distributed (Redis/Memcached), and CDN caching layers; eviction policies (LRU, LFU), cache stampede prevention, and write-through vs. write-behind patterns.

concepts.name: CDN
concepts.summary: Content delivery networks that serve static and dynamic assets from edge PoPs, reducing origin load and cutting cross-region latency for end users.

concepts.name: API Design
concepts.summary: REST, GraphQL, and gRPC API design principles including versioning, idempotency, pagination, and error-handling conventions for public-facing services.

concepts.name: Rate Limiting
concepts.summary: Token bucket, leaky bucket, sliding window, and fixed window algorithms that enforce per-client quotas to protect services from abuse and overload.

concepts.name: Databases
concepts.summary: Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB, Cassandra, MongoDB) database fundamentals, indexing strategies, and query optimisation.

concepts.name: Replication
concepts.summary: Leader-follower and multi-leader replication, replication lag, read replicas, and failover mechanisms that keep data available when nodes fail.

concepts.name: Sharding
concepts.summary: Horizontal data partitioning by key range, hash, or directory; consistent hashing rings; and re-sharding strategies for growing data sets.

concepts.name: Consistency
concepts.summary: CAP theorem, eventual vs. strong vs. causal consistency, linearisability, and the practical trade-offs between read freshness and availability.

concepts.name: Durability
concepts.summary: Write-ahead logging (WAL), checkpointing, RAID, cross-region backups, and RPO/RTO targets that determine how much data loss a system can tolerate.

concepts.name: Concurrency Control
concepts.summary: Optimistic and pessimistic locking, MVCC, two-phase locking, and distributed transactions (2PC, Saga) for coordinating concurrent writes.

concepts.name: Message Queues
concepts.summary: Point-to-point and pub/sub messaging with RabbitMQ, SQS, and Kafka; dead-letter queues, acknowledgement semantics, and at-least-once delivery guarantees.

concepts.name: Stream Processing
concepts.summary: Real-time event processing with Kafka Streams, Flink, and Spark Streaming; windowing, watermarking, and exactly-once semantics.

concepts.name: Reliability Engineering
concepts.summary: Retry policies, circuit breakers, timeouts, bulkheads, and chaos engineering practices that make services recover gracefully from failures.

concepts.name: Observability
concepts.summary: The three pillars—metrics, logs, and distributed traces—and the tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger) used to understand system behaviour.

concepts.name: Embeddings & Vector Search
concepts.summary: Dense vector representations of text, images, and code; ANN indexing (HNSW, IVF); and hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion.

concepts.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
concepts.summary: Architecture patterns for grounding LLM responses in retrieved documents: chunking, indexing, re-ranking, query rewriting, and quality evaluation.

concepts.name: LLM Inference
concepts.summary: Serving large language models efficiently: continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantisation, speculative decoding, and disaggregated prefill/decode.

concepts.name: Agentic Systems
concepts.summary: LLM-powered agents with tools, memory, and planning; multi-agent orchestration; loop prevention; and evaluation frameworks for long-horizon tasks.

concepts.name: Fine-tuning
concepts.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), full fine-tuning, dataset curation, catastrophic forgetting mitigation, and trade-offs with in-context learning.

concepts.name: Evaluation
concepts.summary: Benchmark design, LLM-as-judge, RAGAS, human evaluation, A/B testing, and the metrics used to compare model and system quality objectively.

concepts.name: Multimodal Systems
concepts.summary: Unified and late-fusion architectures for text, image, audio, and video; ColPali document retrieval; VLMs for generation; and multimodal evaluation.
